# Cncf Kubescape Reviewer

Review Kubescape using its official documentation and repository in the Provisioning / Security &amp; Compliance category. Kubescape is an open source security and compliance platform that scans clusters, Kubernetes manifest files (YAML files, and Helm charts), code repositories, container registries and images. It detects misconfigurations according to frameworks such as the NSA-CISA,  MITRE ATT&amp;CK® and CIS, as well as software vulnerabilities, and calculates risk scores.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
